notes: Verbless clause with a noun subject and a prepositional predicate rendered by a presentative frame: 'there is' belongs to the predicate preposition בֵּין under rule 49's closing paragraph and rule 20's dummy-there sentence, exactly as 1SA.20.21 places 'there is' on the לְ of שָׁלוֹם לְךָ. The verse pass had put the frame on the subject noun פֶּשַׂע.
